name: sidecar-ts
description: Thin gRPC wrapper over the official @pendle/sdk-boros SDK. Signs/encodes nothing itself.

scripts.test: tsc --outDir dist-test src/config.ts src/errorMapping.ts src/errorMapping.test.ts src/secrets.ts src/secrets.test.ts src/service.ts src/service.test.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test dist-test/errorMapping.test.js dist-test/secrets.test.js dist-test/service.test.js && rm -rf dist-test
